correspondenceMechanism.chosen: tag-path SUFFIX >= 2 segments, greedy one-to-one, tie-broken by geometric IoU then sibling-ordinal distance
fallbacks: ancestor-mapped: source box mapped through the nearest PAIRED ancestor region, scale guard 1.35
source-rect: the raw source rectangle, gated on alignedGeometry (page heights within 15%, >= 3 pairs, both median offsets <= 16px)

rejected.exact-structural-path: 0% hit rate on every one of the 6 measured pairs — the generator bolts a fixed shell prefix onto every clone path
rejected.suffix-k1: one tag name; pairs unrelated divs
rejected.suffix-k3-k4: loses 8-13 points (k=3) and up to half the census (k=4) for no measured precision gain
rejected.leaf-set-carry: yields no box, swings 38-92% across pairs, and answers the question missing-text-ratio already answers (0.0 on the pair this channel exists for)
rejected.raw-rectangle-ungated: off by 5,269px and 8,666px on hobbang.net; kept only behind alignedGeometry

evidenceLegs.inkPrecondition: inkTrustOf(side): screenshot present, same height and >= viewport width (tol 0.02), and min(deepest painted leaf, scrollHeight)/scrollHeight >= 0.8
